comment: Every version QGSDK installs, in one place. The scripts and CI read this file; change a version here, nowhere else. See docs/manifest.md.

python.comment: QGSDK's own tooling runs on this Python. It ships with QGSDK and never with QGLogger. No installer, no admin rights, nothing written outside the prefix. Windows: python.org's official build, as its NuGet package (a zip). Linux: python-build-standalone, the relocatable CPython build uv uses (a tarball); the system Python is never used.

aqtinstall.comment: Installs Qt and its tools without a Qt account. Pinned to a commit: Qt 6.11 changed its repository layout and no release since 3.3.0 reads it (docs/decisions/0002).
aqtinstall.version_comment: A source zip has no git history, so the version aqtinstall would read from git is given here (SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION). No git needed on the machine.

linux.comment: Built with GCC; the compiler is the system's (any GCC with C++17), with the OpenGL, EGL and xkbcommon headers Qt's CMake files look for. The bootstrap checks for them; QGSDK never installs system packages.

windows.name: MinGW
windows.comment: Qt's MinGW binaries are ABI-matched to this compiler. Mixing versions gives crashes that look like application bugs.

downloads.comment: Tools that don't come from Qt's repositories: downloaded from their publisher, checked against the SHA-256 here, unpacked under <prefix>/tools/<name>.

windows.name: NSIS
windows.comment: Makes QGLogger's Windows installer (CPack's NSIS generator). The portable zip: no installer, no admin rights. SHA-256 taken from the download, which matched the SHA-1 SourceForge publishes for it.
